annotations.label: T cells (IL7R+ LTB+ AQP3+ memory/activated-like; CD4 vs CD8 identity not established)
annotations.notes: Computed: IL7R 78% vs 32%, plus LTB, AQP3, CD3D, CD3E and CD2, are enriched. CD4 is detected in 15% and CD8A in 5%, so detection is sparse. I removed the CD4-like claim from the label. Retrieved: abstracts name CD3D/CD3E/CD2 as T-cell genes. None supports IL7R, LTB or AQP3.

annotations.label: T cells (naive-like, CCR7+ LDHB+; CD4/CD8 split unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: LDHB and CCR7 (52% vs 13%) are enriched, with ribosomal genes. CD3D is detected in 88%, CD3E 78%, SELL 66%, CD4 7% and CD8B 26%. CD3D/CD3E did not differ from cluster 0. Naive-like is an inference. Retrieved: abstracts support CD3D/CD3E only, not LDHB or CCR7.

annotations.label: B cells (naive-like features inferred)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD79A (94% vs 4%), MS4A1, CD79B, TCL1A, BANK1 and VPREB3 are enriched, with MHC class II genes. Membership matches the baseline B cluster (235/235 shared baseline B cells recovered in the downsample). Retrieved: 38770541 names CD79A and MS4A1 as B-cell markers, but in one CLL patient. Naive-like is an untested inference.

annotations.label: Cytotoxic T cells (GZMK+ CD8A+ effector/memory-like)
annotations.notes: Computed: NKG7, CCL5, GZMA, GZMK, CST7 and CD8A are enriched. CD3D is detected in 85%, CD8A in 48%, CD8B in 35% and KLRF1 in 4.5%. This split is not testable at 0.6 and is resolution-sensitive, so tentative. Retrieved: abstracts support NKG7 and CD8A in T/NK contexts, not GZMK, CCL5, GZMA or CST7.

annotations.label: CD14+ classical monocytes (S100-high)
annotations.notes: Computed: S100A8 (99% vs 20%), S100A9, LGALS2, FCN1, LYZ and CD14 (59% vs 10%) are enriched. FCGR3A is detected in 6%. Versus cluster 5, S100A8/S100A9 are higher and HLA class II lower. Retrieved: the abstracts link S100A8/S100A9 to classical or CD14++ monocytes. None covers LGALS2, FCN1 or LYZ.

annotations.label: CD14+ monocytes (HLA-DR/CD68-high; classical vs intermediate unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: CD14 (73% vs 9%), LGALS2, FCN1, MS4A6A, S100A8 and CD68 are enriched. FCGR3A is detected in 24%. Versus cluster 4, HLA class II and CD68 are higher and S100A8/S100A9 lower. Subtype is an unresolved inference. Retrieved: abstracts cover CD14++ monocytes and S100A8, not CD68, MS4A6A, LGALS2 or FCN1. Clusters 4 and 5 jointly hold 485/523 baseline CD14 cells.

annotations.label: T cells (ribosomal-gene-high, low-complexity; subtype unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed: top markers are mostly ribosomal genes and MALAT1. CD3D (78% vs 50%) and IL32 are enriched, and CD3E is detected in 61%. Median genes are 590, the lowest of any cluster, so low-RNA effects are possible. Versus cluster 1, CCL5, GZMK and NKG7 are higher. Not testable at 0.6. Retrieved: abstracts support CD3D only. No CD4/CD8 call.

annotations.label: FCGR3A+ (CD16+) non-classical monocytes
annotations.notes: Computed: FCGR3A (96% vs 14%), MS4A7, CDKN1C, LILRA3, CSF1R and LST1 are enriched. CD14 is detected in 17% and cytotoxic genes are low. Tentative in every run: the abstracts give label-level support only (CD14lowCD16high or CD16+ non-classical monocytes), and none names MS4A7, CDKN1C or LILRA3. Merged with CD14 monocytes at 0.3.

annotations.label: NK-like cells (CD16+ cytotoxic; NK identity inferred)
annotations.notes: Computed: GZMB, FGFBP2, SPON2, PRF1, GNLY, KLRD1 and NKG7 (100%) are enriched. FCGR3A is detected in 89%, KLRF1 27%, NCAM1 7%, CD3D 8% and CD4 0%. NK over T cell is an inference. Not testable at 0.6. Retrieved: abstracts support GNLY/NKG7/GZMB/PRF1 as cytotoxic genes, not NK-specific (cytotoxic CD4+ T cells also express them, per 42609202).

annotations.label: Dendritic cell-like (CD1C+ FCER1A+ cDC2-like; pDC admixture and doublets not excluded)
annotations.notes: Computed: FCER1A (83% vs 1%), CLEC10A, CD1C and SERPINF1 are enriched in 36 cells. CLEC4C is detected in 17%, LILRA4 14%, CD3D 17%, CD79A 17% and NKG7 33%. Median counts are 5297 vs 1264–3841 elsewhere. Per-cell co-detection was not computed, so doublets are unresolved. Retrieved: 38582791 covers FCER1A+CD1C+ DCs (tumor). 35101945 is iPSC-derived cDC2, indirect only.

annotations.label: Platelet-like cells (very small cluster; aggregates vs ambient RNA unresolved)
annotations.notes: Computed (n=10): GP9 90%, PF4 90%, ITGA2B 80%, PPBP 100%, GP1BA 60%. LYZ 70%, S100A9 50% and HLA-DRA 60% co-detected; CD3D 0%. Aggregates versus ambient RNA is undistinguished. Retrieved: no PBMC platelet literature; 30721642 covers GP9/ITGA2B in isolated platelets only.
